skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop proficiency in reading, writing, translating, and presenting real estate-related content in English.
Understand and analyze real estate markets, brokerage, management, valuation, and finance.
Work effectively in teams, demonstrating responsibility and accountability.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate and present real estate issues.
Communicate effectively in both individual and group settings using English.
Collect and analyze information from various sources in English.
Deliver effective presentations on real estate topics in English.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility in professional real estate decision-making.
